summary: Frontend-only testing completed. Homepage, public pages, TEILEKLAR storefront, and cart persistence all working. Critical auth system issue found - protected pages show membership_required error despite successful login.

critical_bugs.issue: All protected pages return membership_required error: 'Die Sitzung und die erforderliche Mandanten-, Seiten- und Rollenfreigabe sind hier nicht verifiziert.' Login redirects successfully but session/permissions not verified.
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks all authenticated admin and customer portal access

ui_bugs.issue: German compound headline missing space: 'Ein Anspruch.Ein zusammenhängenderAuftritt.' should be 'Ein Anspruch. Ein zusammenhängender Auftritt.'
Could not find locale option with data-testid='locale-option-en' for testing locale switch
After page.reload(), cart count briefly shows 0 before updating (timing issue). Cart data persists correctly.

passed_tests: Homepage desktop (1920x800): typography, images (Higgsfield originals), cards, no console errors, single H1
Homepage mobile (390x844): responsive layout, all 3 gallery cards visible
Public pages: /leistungen, /leistungen/websites (8 questions), /kontakt (form present), /impressum, /wissen - all load correctly with single H1
No CSS parse errors across all pages
TEILEKLAR storefront (/teileklar): loads with 3 window products, original images from CDN (naturalWidth: 1200)
TEILEKLAR shop (/teileklar/shop): 24 product cards, filters (stock, category), sort dropdown, search present
Product images: External CDN images (cdnbigbuy.com) load correctly with naturalWidth verification
CRITICAL: Cart persistence verified - cart persists across page.reload() AND page.goto() in same browser context
Cart operations: Add to cart, quantity change, remove button all present and functional
Checkout flow: Accessible with address form (Vorname, Nachname, Straße, PLZ, Ort, E-Mail). Stopped before live order as requested.
Login flow: /anmelden accepts credentials and redirects to /intern/leitstand (but protected pages have auth error)
Structured data: Homepage has JSON-LD with @graph structure
HomeMaster.css: Consistently applied across public pages

critical: Fix auth system: All protected pages (/intern/leitstand, /intern/posteingang, /portal/kunde) return membership_required error despite successful login. Session/permissions not being verified correctly.
medium: Fix H1 typography: Add space in 'Ein Anspruch.Ein zusammenhängenderAuftritt.' -> 'Ein Anspruch. Ein zusammenhängender Auftritt.'
Configure robots.txt and sitemap.xml - both appear empty or invalid
low: Investigate locale selector structure for testing (data-testid for locale options)
